pages.title: Eight guardians
text: Every March biome keeps a **guardian**: the thing each tribe's story ends at (see [Elders, requests and stories](elders_and_stories)). They are bosses in every sense: a boss bar, no knockback, no potions, no Soul Urn, two phases, and a fight worth preparing for.

A guardian never wanders in. Each has a **ground** in its biome, a ring of stone with a **Guardian Altar** at its centre, and it rises only from that altar: the altar must sit on polished deepslate with a lit candle at each corner (altar or nothing), there must be room above it, and it rests about twenty minutes between calls.
Sneak-use the altar with an empty hand and it tells you what it wants: a fistful of that biome's reagent, eight by default. Lay it on and stand back.

pages.title: Two phases
text: At half health every guardian is **roused**: its signature attack comes faster and harder, and it calls its biome's creatures to its side. Those creatures drop nothing and vanish when it falls. Leave the ground for half a minute and the guardian goes back to sleep; the altar still needs its rest.
When it falls, everyone within reach who is on that tribe's story finishes the **trial**, and its **core** drops with a heap of its biome's reagents.

pages.title: Slag Titan
text: **The Slag Throne in the Ember Wastes**. Called with Magma Scales. Sneak to brace against its slams; in its second phase the rings ignite and Cinder Imps rise from the slag.
Drops the **Slag Core**.

pages.title: Bog Matriarch
text: **The Drowned Root in the Reed Fen**. Called with Reed Fangs. Its snare drags you in and slows you; keep to solid ground, and cut down the Reed Stalkers it calls before they swarm.
Drops the **Fen Heart**.

pages.title: Cairn Wight
text: **The Cairn Ring in the Snow Fields**. Called with Rime Mandibles. Its breath freezes everything in front of it. Circle behind; the Rime Crawlers it calls are slow.
Drops the **Cairn Stone**.

pages.title: Prism Serpent
text: **The Singing Fracture in the Crystal Fields**. Called with Prism Carapace. It fires bolts of light that mark you glowing. Strafe, close in, and watch the second bolt it adds in phase two.
Drops the **Prism Core**.

pages.title: Vault Sentinel
text: **The Sealed Gate on Glimmer Ridge**. Called with Sentinel Sigils. The heaviest armour in the March, and a sweep that throws you off the ridge. In phase two it wards itself for three seconds at a time: wait it out.
Drops the **Vault Seal**.

pages.title: Tide Drummer
text: **The Tide Stone in the Shallows**. Called with Brine Fangs. Each beat pulls everyone toward it and hurts. Fight it from the shore with your back to something solid.
Drops the **Tide Shell**.

pages.title: Stampede Spirit
text: **The Trampled Ring on the Steppe**. Called with Shank Sinew. It charges. Sidestep and hit it as it passes; when Burrow Gnashers surface, stand on a block.
Drops the **Herd Horn**.

pages.title: Storm Roc
text: **The Roost on the Highlands**. Called with Storm Wings. It swoops and throws you into the air, and in phase two lightning follows each swoop. A bow and a roof help more than a shield.
Drops the **Storm Plume**.

pages.title: What the cores are for
text: Each core with a Loom Thread makes six {item:tribalpower:resonant_core}, the fastest way to them in the game. All eight cores together with an {item:tribalpower:unsung_heart} make the tablet of [The Ninth Agreement](ninth_agreement).
